arxiv-1807-07974.title: Heat-Bath Algorithmic Cooling with optimal thermalization strategies
arxiv-1807-07974.creator: Álvaro M. Alhambra, Matteo Lostaglio, Christopher Perry
arxiv-1807-07974.description: Abstract Heat-Bath Algorithmic Cooling is a set of techniques for producing highly pure quantum systems by utilizing a surrounding heat-bath and unitary interactions. These techniques originally used the thermal environment only to fully thermalize ancillas at the environment temperature. Here we extend HBAC protocols by optimizing over the thermalization strategy.

arxiv-1809-05916.title: Curriculum-Based Neighborhood Sampling For Sequence Prediction
arxiv-1809-05916.creator: James O’ Neill, Danushka Bollegala
arxiv-1809-05916.description: Abstract The task of multi-step ahead prediction in language models is challenging considering the discrepancy between training and testing. At test time, a language model is required to make predictions given past predictions as input, instead of the past targets that are provided during training.

arxiv-2105-12761.title: Pairing and superconductivity in quasi one-dimensional flat band systems: Creutz and sawtooth lattices
arxiv-2105-12761.creator: Si Min Chan, B. Grémaud, G. G. Batrouni
arxiv-2105-12761.description: Abstract We study the pairing and superconducting properties of the attractive Hubbard model in two quasi one-dimensional topological lattices, the Creutz and sawtooth lattices, which share two peculiar properties: each of their band structures exhibits a flat band with a non-trivial winding number.

arxiv-2110-15384.title: Quantum synchronisation and clustering in chiral networks
arxiv-2110-15384.creator: Salvatore Lorenzo, Benedetto Militello, Anna Napoli, Roberta Zambrini, G.Massimo Palma
arxiv-2110-15384.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Salvatore Lorenzo, Benedetto Militello, Anna Napoli, Roberta Zambrini, G.Massimo Palma. We study the emergence of synchronisation in a chiral network of harmonic oscillators. The network consists of a set of locally incoherently pumped harmonic oscillators coupled pairwise in cascade with travelling field modes. Such cascaded coupling leads to feedback-less dissipative interaction between the harmonic oscillators of the pair which can be described in terms of an effective pairwise hamiltonian a collective pairwise decay. The network is described mathematically in terms of a directed graph.

arxiv-2202-04560.title: The craft and coordination of data curation: complicating "workflow" views of data science CCS: Human-centered computing Collaborative and social computing systems and tools CCS: Applied computing Document preparation CCS: Information systems Digital libraries and archives
arxiv-2202-04560.creator: Andrea K. Thomer, Dharma Akmon, Jeremy York, Allison R. B. Tyler, Faye Polasek, Sara Lafia, Libby Hemphill, Elizabeth Yakel
arxiv-2202-04560.description: Abstract . Data curation is the process of making a dataset fit-for-use and archiveable. It is critical to data-intensive science because it makes complex data pipelines possible, makes studies reproducible, and makes data (re)usable. Yet the complexities of the hands-on, technical and intellectual work of data curation is frequently overlooked or downplayed.

arxiv-2203-10036.title: On the Generalization Mystery in Deep Learning
arxiv-2203-10036.creator: Satrajit Chatterjee and Piotr Zielinski
arxiv-2203-10036.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Satrajit Chatterjee and Piotr Zielinski. The generalization mystery in deep learning is the following: Why do over-parameterized neural networks trained with gradient descent (GD) generalize well on real datasets even though they are capable of fitting random datasets of comparable size? Furthermore, from among all solutions that fit the training data, how does GD find one that generalizes well (when such a well-generalizing solution exists)?

arxiv-2204-10718.title: Determinants from homomorphisms
arxiv-2204-10718.creator: Radu Curticapean
arxiv-2204-10718.description: Abstract We give a new combinatorial explanation for well-known relations between determinants and traces of matrix powers. Such relations can be used to obtain polynomial-time and poly-logarithmic space algorithms for the determinant. Our new explanation avoids linear-algebraic arguments and instead exploits a classical connection between subgraph and homomorphism counts.

arxiv-2209-05911.title: Computer vision based vehicle tracking as a complementary and scalable approach to RFID tagging DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: Y; 15.00 Price: ; ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/18/06 CCS: Theory of computation Formal languages and automata theory CCS: Computing methodologies Supervised learning
arxiv-2209-05911.creator: Pranav Kant Gaur, Abhilash Bhardwaj, Pritam Shete, Mohini Laghate, Dinesh M Sarode
arxiv-2209-05911.description: Abstract . Logging of incoming/outgoing vehicles serves as a piece of critical information for root-cause analysis to combat security breach incidents in various sensitive organizations. RFID tagging hampers the scalability of vehicle tracking solutions on both logistics as well as technical fronts.

arxiv-2404-11870.title: Enhancing Length Extrapolation in Sequential Models with Pointer-Augmented Neural Memory
arxiv-2404-11870.creator: Hung Le, Dung Nguyen, Kien Do, Svetha Venkatesh, Truyen Tran
arxiv-2404-11870.description: Abstract We propose Pointer-Augmented Neural Memory (PANM) to help neural networks understand and apply symbol processing to new, longer sequences of data. PANM integrates an external neural memory that uses novel physical addresses and pointer manipulation techniques to mimic human and computer symbol processing abilities.

arxiv-2501-08115.title: RoHan: Robust Hand Detection in Operation Room
arxiv-2501-08115.creator: Roi Papo, Sapir Gershov, Tom Friedman, Itay Or, Gil Bolotin, Shlomi Laufer
arxiv-2501-08115.description: Abstract Hand-specific localization has garnered significant interest within the computer vision community. Although there are numerous datasets with hand annotations from various angles and settings, domain transfer techniques frequently struggle in surgical environments. This is mainly due to the limited availability of gloved hand instances and the unique challenges of operating rooms (ORs).

arxiv-2504-19457.title: Towards Long Context Hallucination Detection
arxiv-2504-19457.creator: Siyi Liu, Kishaloy Halder, Zheng Qi, Wei Xiao, Nikolaos Pappas, Phu Mon Htut, Neha Anna John, Yassine Benajiba, Dan Roth
arxiv-2504-19457.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance across various tasks. However, they are prone to contextual hallucination , generating information that is either unsubstantiated or contradictory to the given context. Although many studies have investigated contextual hallucinations in LLMs, addressing them in long-context inputs remains an open problem.

arxiv-2505-24791.title: Accelerating Inference of Discrete AutoregressiveNormalizing Flows by Selective Jacobi Decoding
arxiv-2505-24791.creator: Jiaru Zhang jiaru@purdue.edu, Juanwu Lu juanwu@purdue.edu, Xiaoyu Wu xw105@rice.edu, Ziran Wang ziran@purdue.edu, Ruqi Zhang ruqiz@purdue.edu
arxiv-2505-24791.description: Abstract Discrete normalizing flows are promising generative models with advantages such as analytical log-likelihood computation and end-to-end training. However, the architectural constraints to ensure invertibility and tractable Jacobian computation limit their expressive power and practical usability. Recent advancements utilize autoregressive modeling, significantly enhancing expressive power and generation quality.

arxiv-2506-04875.title: Consciousness via MIPT?
arxiv-2506-04875.creator: Alexander Gorsky 1 ​ ; ​ 2 {}^{1\mathord{\mathchar 59\relax}2}
arxiv-2506-04875.description:
A 2025 arXiv research paper by Alexander Gorsky 1 ​ ; ​ 2 {}^{1\mathord{\mathchar 59\relax}2}. Abstract

The measurement-induced phase transition (MIPT) is a recently formulated phenomenon in out-of-equilibrium systems. The competition between unitary evolutions and measurement-induced non-unitaries leads to the transition between the entangled and disentangled phases at some critical measurement rate. We conjecture that self-organized MIPT plays a key role in the generative model of cognitive networks and the formation of the state of consciousness in the "newborn-adult" transition.

arxiv-2507-18343.title: Hybrid Annotation for Propaganda Detection: Integrating LLM Pre-Annotations with Human Intelligence
arxiv-2507-18343.creator: Ariana Sahitaj, Premtim Sahitaj, Veronika Solopova, Jiaao Li, Sebastian Möller, Vera Schmitt
arxiv-2507-18343.description: Abstract Propaganda detection on social media remains challenging due to task complexity and limited high-quality labeled data. This paper introduces a novel framework that combines human expertise with Large Language Model (LLM) assistance to improve both annotation consistency and scalability. We propose a hierarchical taxonomy that organizes 14 fine-grained propaganda techniques Martino et al.

arxiv-2512-07932.title: Is disorder a friend or a foe to melting of Wigner-Mott insulators?
arxiv-2512-07932.creator: Mohammed Hammam, Cyprian Lewandowski, Vladimir Dobrosavljevic, Sandeep Joy
arxiv-2512-07932.description: Abstract Wigner crystals are extremely fragile, which is shown to result from very strong geometric frustration germane to long-range Coulomb interactions. Physically, this is manifested by a very small characteristic energy scale for shear density fluctuations, which are gapless excitations in a translationally invariant system.

arxiv-2601-15976.title: Weyl-transverse gravity with boundaries
arxiv-2601-15976.creator: Gloria Odak, Salvatore Ribisi
arxiv-2601-15976.description: Abstract We develop the covariant phase space formulation of Weyl–transverse gravity (WTG) in the presence of general timelike and spacelike boundaries. WTG is classically equivalent to General Relativity (GR) but possesses a reduced gauge symmetry consisting of Weyl transformations and transverse diffeomorphisms, together with a fixed background volume form.

arxiv-2601-23072.title: SplineFlow: Flow Matching for Dynamical Systems with B-Spline Interpolants
arxiv-2601-23072.creator: Santanu Subhash Rathod, Pietro Liò, Xiao Zhang
arxiv-2601-23072.description: Abstract Flow matching is a scalable generative framework for characterizing continuous normalizing flows with wide-range applications. However, current state-of-the-art methods are not well-suited for modeling dynamical systems, as they construct conditional paths using linear interpolants that may not capture the underlying state evolution, especially when learning higher-order dynamics from irregular sampled observations.

pmc-10537525.title: Effects of Lactoferrin on Oral and Throat Conditions under Low Humidity Environments: A Randomized, Double-Blind, and Placebo-Controlled Crossover Trial
pmc-10537525.creator: Shutaro Kubo, Hirotsugu Oda, Miyuki Tanaka, Takashi Koikeda, Shinichi Tomita, Esben Skipper Sørensen
pmc-10537525.description: To evaluate the effects of a single ingestion of bovine lactoferrin (bLF) on oral and throat conditions under a low-humidity environment. A randomized, double-blind, 2-sequence, 2-treatment, and 2-period placebo-controlled crossover trial was conducted. Healthy adult subjects orally ingested bLF dissolved in water, or placebo water, followed by exposure to low humidity (20 °C, 20% relative humidity (RH)) for 2 h.

pmc-10584000.title: Higher Peripheral Thyroid Sensitivity Is Linked to a Lower Risk of Heart Failure After Acute Myocardial Infarction
pmc-10584000.creator: Xueyan Lang, Bing Zhao, Shaohong Fang, Lulu Li, Zhaoying Li, Nilian Wu, Yuheng Zhang, Lei Xing, Yilan Li, Yao Zhang
pmc-10584000.description: ContextIt is still not clear how the free triiodothyronine (FT3) to free thyroxine (FT4) ratio affects the prognosis of acute myocardial infarction (AMI), especially the risk of heart failure (HF) subsequent to AMI.ObjectiveThe purpose of this study was to see how peripheral sensitivity to thyroid hormones, as measured by the FT3/FT4 ratio, affected HF and mortality after AMI.

pmc-10670943.title: Recent Insights about the Role of Gels in Organic Photonics and Electronics
pmc-10670943.creator: Josué M Galindo, Carlos Tardío, Basanta Saikia, Stijn Van Cleuvenbergen, Iván Torres-Moya, Yi-Zhou Zhang
pmc-10670943.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). This review article provides an in-depth exploration of the role of gels in the fields of organic electronics and photonics, focusing on their unique properties and applications. Despite their remarkable potential, gel-based innovations remain relatively uncharted in these domains. This brief review aims to bridge the knowledge gap by shedding light on the diverse roles that gels can fulfil in the enhancement of organic electronic and photonic devices.

pmc-12748516.title: Fontan‐Associated Liver Disease: Trends Over Time and Relationship With Outcomes
pmc-12748516.creator: Mikyla Janzen, Parm Khakh, Defen Peng, Gnalini Sathananthan, Marla Kiess, Santabhanu Chakrabarti, Jasmine Grewal
pmc-12748516.description: BackgroundFontan associated liver disease is a poorly understood complication of long‐term single ventricle palliation. This study sought to describe serial liver function changes in patients with a Fontan circulation from 2014 to 2020 and determine if these findings can be used to predict adverse clinical outcomes.

pmc-13059114.title: Glioblastoma invasion into different organoid hosts reveals cell-intrinsic and proliferative migratory programs
pmc-13059114.creator: Christopher Y Akhunbay-Fudge, Bronwyn K Irving, Alima Ismail, Sabrina Samuel, Emma Smedley, Holly E Bradford, Steven Bagley, Alexander Baker, Iain M Hagan, Deena MA Gendoo, Kevin Critchley, Ryan K Mathew, Heiko Wurdak
pmc-13059114.description: SummaryAkhunbay-Fudge et al. develop two complementary single-cell profiling methods to determine glioblastoma (GB) invasion phenotypes, focusing on the influence of host organoid developmental lineage (neural versus endodermal) and cell cycle progression on GB invasion within tumor assembloids. Notably, GB cells invaded both neural and endodermal organoid hosts, whereas non-malignant adult brain cells lacked this capacity.

pmc-13206211.title: Solvent‐Controlled Chemoselectivity in Brønsted Acidic Deep Eutectic Mixtures: A Metal‐Free One‐Pot Cascade Meyer‐Schuster/C–P Bond Formation
pmc-13206211.creator: Gloria Morís‐Menéndez, Nicolás Ríos‐Lombardía, Marina Ramos‐Martín, Alejandro Presa Soto, Joaquín García‐Álvarez
pmc-13206211.description: One‐pot tandem methodologies offer powerful opportunities to enhance step economy while reducing waste, energy input, and operational complexity, thereby directly aligning with the Principles of Green Chemistry. Thus, herein, we report a one‐pot cascade, metal‐free Meyer‐Schuster/C‐P (and C‐Cl) bond‐forming protocol enabled by Brønsted Acidic Deep Eutectic Solvents (BADESs), which act simultaneously as solvent, promoter and chemoselectivity controller.

pmc-13228945.title: Expenditures attributable to infant lower respiratory tract infection due to respiratory syncytial virus in the US: A real-world study using the PharMetrics Plus Database, 2015–2023
pmc-13228945.creator: Ahuva Averin, Amy W. Law, Mark Atwood, Erin Quinn, Derek Weycker
pmc-13228945.description: While several studies have reported the episodic expenditures attributable to lower respiratory tract illness due to respiratory syncytial virus (RSV-LRTI) among US infants, published estimates vary widely. Moreover, it is unknown whether expenditures due to infant RSV-LRTI vary relative to the RSV season or COVID-19 pandemic.

pmc-13330378.title: Prenatal training grounds: the developmental origins of chronic immune disease
pmc-13330378.creator: Sameeksha Chopra, Naomi Madokoro, Mya Bal, Kelly M McNagny
pmc-13330378.description: BackgroundImmune cells seed tissues in orchestrated waves beginning in utero. While the impact of prenatal environmental exposures is well-documented in neuroimmunology, the influence of maternal-fetal interactions on systemic immune development and its contribution to lifelong chronic inflammatory disease remains underappreciated.

pmc-13458984.title: Endobronchial Myoepithelioma With Fluorodeoxyglucose Uptake
pmc-13458984.creator: Taro Abe, Keitaro Nakamoto, Eriko Ieki, Miku Oda, Yoshifumi Hirata, Isao Kataoka, Kazuharu Suda, Aya Isomura, Junji Shibahara, Yutaka Suzuki
pmc-13458984.description: Myoepitheliomas of the respiratory organs are extremely rare. We report a case of endobronchial myoepithelioma in a 43‐year‐old woman presenting to hospital with a cough. Chest computed tomography (CT) showed consolidation in the lingular segment of her left upper lobe. She was initially diagnosed as having pneumonia and treated with antibiotics, but her symptoms persisted.

pmc-13511456.title: Post-Intubation Hypotension After Titrated Induction with Ciprofol versus Propofol in Older Adults Undergoing Non-Cardiac Surgery: A Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-13511456.creator: Hong Bai, Jing Guo, Yumei Li, Song Zhang, Siying Chen, Zhen Wang, Kun Lu, Lizhen Zhang, Fenghua Zhong, Ruirui Gong, Jianshan Li, Jiaxin Han, Xuemei Song, Sanqing Jin
pmc-13511456.description: PurposeTo compare ciprofol with propofol for titrated induction of anesthesia in older adults undergoing non-cardiac surgery, with a focus on post-intubation hypotension and related hemodynamic burden.MethodsIn this prospective, randomized, double-blind trial, adults aged 65–89 years undergoing elective non-cardiac surgery were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to receive either ciprofol or propofol, following an identical titration-to-effect induction protocol.

pmc-13534574.title: CAMK2A通过激活ERK信号通路调控口腔鳞癌细胞紫杉醇耐药性
pmc-13534574.creator: Junfeng Wang, Hongli Chen, Jiao Chen, Yun Feng, Yao Yuan, Ping Zhang
pmc-13534574.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). 目的研究钙离子信号通路调控口腔鳞癌（oral squamous cell carcinoma, OSCC）细胞紫杉醇耐药生存的分子机制。方法通过紫杉醇低剂量持续诱导且剂量递增法诱导构建口腔鳞癌紫杉醇耐药细胞模型；使用Cell Counting Kit-8（CCK-8）和成像流式评估耐药模型的稳定性；通过RNA-seq测序分析差异基因和功能富集；使用实时荧光定量PCR（quantitative real-time PCR, qPCR）分析CAMK2a基因差异表达；通过蛋白质免疫印迹法（Western blot）检测蛋白质表达水平；用KN93及CAMK2a siRNA抑制CAMK2a表达。结果成功构建紫杉醇耐药口腔鳞癌细胞模型；测序的GO富集结果显示耐药细胞在钙离子信号通路具有差异，其中CAMK2家族多种基因表达增加，CAMK2a分子表达增加12%（P<0.05）；通过使用CAMK2a抑制剂KN93和siRNA基因敲低技术抑制CAMK2a后，耐药细胞增殖能力降低35%（P<0.0001），同时p-Erk1/2和下游分子表达降低。结论CAMK2a通过激活MAPK-Erk1/2通路，调控耐药细胞的耐药性和增殖能力，是临床耐药患者治疗的潜在新靶点。Keywords: 口腔鳞癌, 钙离子信号通路, 紫杉醇耐药, CAMK2a, 靶点 口腔鳞状细胞癌（oral squamous cell carcinoma, OSCC）是头颈部常见的恶性肿瘤之一，起源于口腔黏膜上皮。2022年全球新发病例约389 485例[1-2]。目前治疗手段多样，但手术联合化疗仍是主要方案。然而，随着化疗疗程延长，多数患者逐渐产生耐药，导致预后不良。因此，深入探讨OSCC耐药机制，对于应对临床耐药现象、改善患者预后具有重要意义。 紫杉醇（paclitaxel, PTX）是一种经典的微管稳定剂类抗肿瘤药物，最初从太平洋红豆杉树皮中提取。作为一线化疗药物，紫杉醇通过多种机制诱导肿瘤细胞死亡，在头颈部鳞状细胞癌中，若患者无法耐受顺铂，常将紫杉醇作为替代治疗药物[3-4]。在复发或转移性患者中，紫杉醇单药治疗的缓解率约为40%[5]。然而，目前关于紫杉醇在OSCC中耐药机制的研究较少[6]，因此探索OSCC紫杉醇耐药的分子机制，对于改善顺铂不耐受患者的治疗结局具有重要临床意义。 化疗耐药的形成是多因素共同作用的结果，其中药物外排增强与肿瘤缺氧反应是两个较为经典的耐药机制。ABC转运蛋白家族是引起药物外排增强的重要分子[7]。在肿瘤缺氧环境中，低氧诱导因子-1α（hypoxia inducible factor-1α, HIF-1α）作为核心转录因子，可上调ABC转运蛋白家族的表达，从而参与耐药的形成[8]。此外，已有研究表明钙离子信号变化与HIF-1α之间存在调控关系[9-10]。以上研究提示，钙信号通路可能通过调控HIF-1α/ABC转运蛋白轴，参与肿瘤细胞药物外排及耐药过程。 钙离子信号通路是一类通过钙离子作为第二信使调控细胞增殖、凋亡等生物学过程的重要信号通路。钙调蛋白（calmodulin, CAM）是一种高度保守的钙离子感受蛋白，通过结合Ca2+发生构象改变，进而激活或调节多种下游靶蛋白。其中，钙调蛋白依赖性蛋白激酶Ⅱ（Ca2+/Calmodulin-dependent protein kinase Ⅱ, CAMK2）是CAM信号通路的重要下游效应分子。当细胞内钙离子浓度升高时，CAM与Ca2+复合体，进一步与CAMK2结合并诱导其自磷酸化，使CAMK2在钙信号消退后仍保持激活状态。研究表明，CAMK2突变不但与神经发育障碍相关，同时钙信号及CAMK2的异常也可能促进肿瘤的增殖、迁移和恶性进展[11-13]。CAMK2的四个亚基（α、β、γ、δ）被认为可能与多种癌症的恶性表型和耐药性相关[14]，但其具体机制尚不明确。 基于上述研究背景，本研究构建了口腔鳞癌紫杉醇耐药细胞株，探讨CAMK2在耐药细胞中的作用机制，并评估通过调控CAMK2相关分子抑制肿瘤细胞增殖的策略，以期为理解耐药机制和寻找治疗靶点提供依据。 材料与方法 材料 pmc-13589282.description: This cross-sectional study examines trends, risk factors, and adverse maternal outcomes associated with periviable vaginal vs cesarean delivery.
